entries.definition: The doing of God's commandments — the law kept, worn as the garment of righteous acts; not a vague goodness nor a verdict only received.
entries.common_view: Commonly taught: right standing before God — Christ's imputed righteousness received by faith apart from works.
entries.citations: (Deut 6:25; Ps 119:172; 1 John 3:7) · see Garments & Armor, ch. 43
